thread:
marina: Heads-up: two enterprise customers asked for formal 'pin' commitments when a model is slated for retirement. They want explicit timelines, migration guarantees, and a rollback promise. Can we draft a minimal SOW checklist that product can attach to deals?

devon: From eng-ml: we need a benchmark spec before committing. Minimum: p95 latency, token-cost delta, top-1 accuracy/regression on their evals, and a factuality check on a customer prompt slice.

sana: Ops requirement: must include an ops playbook with automated reroute + a documented fallback for pinned tenants. No playbook = no pin.

tyler: Sales note: two AEs asked for a 6-month pin window. They'll negotiate credits if parity isn't achievable. We should make a template for commercial exceptions.

ev an: Customer-success translation: when they say "pin" they mean (1) reserved access to old model, (2) a staged upgrade path with validation, (3) a hard deprecation date and rollback runbook.

devon: Implementation constraints: supporting pinned legacy instances implies capacity reservation and an autoscaler override. We'll need a pricing addendum and a sandbox for customers to validate upgrades.

marina: Proposed SOW checklist fields: Scope (model + version IDs), Benchmarks (eval names + pass/fail thresholds), Migration window (start/end), Ops (rollback drill steps + contacts), Pricing & credits, Escalation path. Keep it concise.

legal-bot: Note: any absolute "guarantee" language will trigger indemnity and audit clauses. Recommend using measurable gates and "reasonable efforts" phrasing.

sana: Agreed. Product owns the customer-facing checklist, eng-ml publishes the benchmark spec, sales owns the commercial template, ops owns the runbook.

tyler: I can draft the commercial exception template. Product — can you draft the SOW checklist? Also need a one-liner for AE to collect from customers: sample prompts, SLO targets, % traffic pinned.

devon: Draft benchmark spec (short form) to include in SOW:

```
- Eval suites: e.g., customer-prod-regress-v3, hallucination-smoke-2026
- Metrics: p50/p95 latency (ms), tokens/sec, relative token-cost (%), top-1 exact-match delta, hallucination-rate (annotated)
- Acceptance: <=5% relative top-1 degradation AND <=1% absolute increase in hallucination on the customer's critical prompt set
```

sana: Add a hard launch gate: benchmarks pass + sandbox run (>=1M tokens) + ops drill (2 simulated failovers). That gives us a clear risk bar.

ev an: Also include communications milestones: 60/30/7 day notices, test traffic windows, rollback message templates, and support POC list.

marina: Action items: sana -> customer SOW checklist by EOD Wed; devon -> detailed benchmark spec & validation steps link; tyler -> commercial exception draft; evan -> comms checklist. I'll assemble appendix for legal and schedule sign-off Fri.

tyler: I'll also offer temporary migration credits to the two customers and coordinate with AE. :+1:

legal-bot: For appendix include: pinned instance termination clause (min 30d notice), emergency rollback SLA, and a clause limiting liabilities tied to third-party model regressions.

marina: Great. If anyone thinks of more required fields (telemetry hooks, audit logs, data residency constraints), drop them here before Thurs. Reconvene Fri for final sign-off.
